AssertionError: an empty cart must be rejected: 201 {"billing_street":"Lesingel 8","billing_city":"Steensel","billing_state":"Noord-Holland","billing_country":"NL","billing_postal_code":"1012AB","user_id":"01m7mfkztcrh1w0qgn83nvzrte","invoice_date":"20

XFAIL BUG: ordering does not reduce stock; admin stock stays the same after a 201 order, e.g. Hammer 24 -> 24 after 3 units (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: stock of Combination Pliers must drop by at least the 1 ordered, else we oversell: 25 -> 25
assert 25 <= (25 - 1)
Ordering reduces stock by the ordered quantity
